title: Club Membership: cancellation notice period basis
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which a Club Membership cancellation becomes effective, and the member's right to withdraw the request before that point.

## Per-tier notice period
| Tier | Cancellation notice period |
|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 30 calendar days |
| Student Metro Access | 15 calendar days |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 30 calendar days |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 30 calendar days |
| Premier All-Access | 30 calendar days |
| Black Card All-Access | 30 calendar days |
| Founding Legacy Access | 30 calendar days |

## Eligibility: the notice period must have elapsed
A cancellation becomes effective only once the tier's own notice period has elapsed since the customer gives notice of that cancellation. The clock starts from the moment the cancellation request was logged on file, and the notice period is counted as full calendar days from that logged moment, with the boundary day itself counting as satisfied. The closure may not be recorded at a moment earlier than that logged moment plus the tier's own notice period.

## Withdrawal before the boundary
The member may withdraw the cancellation request at any point before that notice-period boundary is reached; a request withdrawn before the boundary never becomes an effective cancellation.

## Boundary cases
For a tier with a 30-day notice period, a cancellation request logged on a given day becomes effective once 30 full calendar days measured from that logged moment have run, counting the boundary day itself as satisfying the period; a request logged one day later, all else equal, becomes effective one calendar day later under the same counting basis. A request withdrawn on any day before its own notice-period boundary is reached never becomes effective, regardless of how close to that boundary the withdrawal occurs.
